$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the resume pack composed with a chef de cuisine's content seed that photographs its person — person.portrait, each role's image and each project's image switch resumeLanding.ts to the photographic résumé (a full-bleed hero, the kitchens on a photographic steps timeline, the work as showcase stories) — and the galley register: Besley over IBM Plex Sans with Plex Mono as the ticket voice, oyster white, cast-iron ink, kelp green. Same computed date math, same print-to-one-page feature (print drops the photographs and returns the hero to ink). Compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Chef résumé
description: A photographic résumé / CV one-pager for a chef: the cook at the pass full-bleed with computed years of experience, every kitchen on a timeline with its photograph and a duration computed from its dates, the numbers, suppers and classes as press-clipping stories, the stations as a ruled four-up, training and a contact block; the same page still typesets to a clean text-only printed résumé.

theme.$comment: The kelp green rides as the brand so app-side surfaces match the galley page (marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent); dark lifts it for the after-close appearance.

landing.$comment: The remix's register and its own skeleton (resolveCatalog merges this over the base pack's landing, keeping its routes): the galley preset and the photographic résumé's sections — the same ids as the base page, so the structural editor and the print stylesheet address them the same way; the types and variants are what resumeLanding.ts builds for a photographed seed.
